errors.evidence: The legend indicates that mBERT is represented by light blue bars and XLM-R is represented by dark blue bars. The description incorrectly swaps these and also misidentifies the color of the XLM-R bars as green instead of dark blue.

errors.text_span: The shortest bars, with a task count approximately equal to 2, are associated with the "same" model for the "IE-Germanic" and "Semitic" language families.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bar for the "same" model in the "IE-Germanic" family has a value of approximately 22, which is one of the taller bars in the chart. While the "same" bar for "Semitic" is low (approx. 1), the association with "IE-Germanic" is completely wrong.
